changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FusionAttributeType') BEGIN IF EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_FusionAttributeType_Parent' and object_name(parent_object_id) = 'FusionAttributeType' and schema_name(schema_id) = 'dbo' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[FusionAttributeType] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_FusionAttributeType_Parent] END exec sp_rename 'dbo.FusionAttributeType', 'FusionAttributeType_backup'; END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FusionAttributeType_backup') BEGIN exec sp_rename 'dbo.FusionAttributeType_backup', 'FusionAttributeType'; END
